# Ammar Shamea — Flutter Developer
> I build Flutter apps and full-stack systems that businesses actually run on.

## About
Flutter and full-stack engineer with 2+ years building production mobile apps and web platforms for restaurants, delivery services, and small businesses across Syria and the region.

## Expertise
Dart, Flutter, Git, Tailwind CSS, AI Integration, BLoC, Figma, Google Maps & Geolocation
